description: This file contains benchmarks for the absl::StrSplit function, including test string generation, various benchmark functions for different split scenarios, and template functions for splitting with different delimiters. It is used for performance testing of string splitting methods in the Abseil library.

methods.name: MakeTestString
methods.description: Generates a test string of a specified length with semicolons inserted at regular intervals.

methods.name: BM_Split2StringView
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into string_view objects using a single delimiter.

methods.name: MakeMultiDelimiterTestString
methods.description: Creates a test string with multiple delimiters cycling through a set of characters.

methods.name: BM_Split2StringViewByAnyChar
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string with multiple delimiters using ByAnyChar.

methods.name: BM_Split2StringViewLifted
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into string_view objects with a fixed delimiter, reusing the result variable.

methods.name: BM_Split2String
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into std::string objects.

methods.name: BM_Split2SplitStringUsing
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting with SkipEmpty option to compare with SplitStringUsing.

methods.name: BM_SplitStringToUnorderedSet
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into an unordered_set of strings.

methods.name: BM_SplitStringToUnorderedMap
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into an unordered_map of string key-value pairs.

methods.name: BM_SplitStringAllowEmpty
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string allowing empty tokens.

methods.name: OneCharLiteral
methods.description: Functor returning a single character delimiter.

methods.name: BM_SplitStringWithOneChar
methods.description: Template benchmark for splitting a string with a single character delimiter, collecting results into a vector.

methods.name: BM_SplitStringWithOneCharNoVector
methods.description: Template benchmark for splitting a string with a single character delimiter, counting elements without storing in a vector.
